response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/backend track record (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and some low-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, C++ audio work on Linux). However, the role's hard requirements are largely unmet: there is no evidence of Japanese language ability (stated languages are English, Romanian, basic German), no Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience, and no embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol work (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, switch SDKs). C for UNIX development appears only briefly a decade ago. The gap between his profile and the position is too fundamental to bridge in a screening round.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many stacks
Some C/C++ and Linux systems exposure (LabWindows/CVI, audio server work)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source ownership
concerns: No indication of native-level Japanese proficiency
No Linux kernel analysis or embedded firmware/switch experience
No security or L2/L3 networking protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP)

key_factors.factor: Senior-level general engineering breadth and C exposure
